हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: When destiny traps mute and innocent Gungun into a forced marriage with the bitter, wheelchair-bound Ahaan, an unexpected bond begins to bloom. Her silence speaks louder than words, slowly breaking through his anger, guilt, and pain. In the shadows of betrayal, power, and family conspiracies, their journey reveals how love can find its voice even in the quietest hearts. Watch Now!
